sources_rejected.name: Bursa Malaysia Company Announcements
sources_rejected.why: Exclusively lists public listed companies (Bhd); target SME private limited companies (Sdn Bhd) are not publicly traded on the exchange and almost never match.

sources_rejected.name: SSM e-Info
sources_rejected.why: Requires paid account login and RM10-RM20 fee per company profile and financial statement; cannot be queried freely without paywall.

sources_rejected.name: MyData-SSM
sources_rejected.why: Official SSM financial reports and corporate profiles require credit card payment and identity authentication per document.

sources_rejected.name: CTOS SME Score
sources_rejected.why: Commercial credit rating service requiring paid enterprise subscription and verified consent from the subject entity.

sources_rejected.name: Experian Malaysia
sources_rejected.why: Commercial credit reporting bureau requiring paid commercial contracts and consent; no open public access.

prompts.not_found_when: Zero tender award notices or bid results match the company name; absence is normal for non-government contractors.
prompts.why_it_matters: Contract award notifications (Surat Setuju Terima) confirm whether the vendor actively wins government procurement and the true value of awards won.
prompts.question: Has the business won or been awarded federal government tenders or contracts on the official MyProcurement portal?
prompts.how_to_query: Search '<business name> site:myprocurement.treasury.gov.my' to inspect published tender award decisions, winning contractors, and contract values. Only published/gazetted tender results are indexed. Tested: J & J Murni Sdn Bhd -> https://myprocurement.treasury.gov.my/. Negative test: NonExistentFakeTendererXYZ -> no match.

source.name: MyProcurement Treasury Malaysia (Pusat Maklumat Perolehan Kerajaan)

prompts.applies_when: Companies that bid for Malaysian federal government tenders, quotations, or direct negotiations
prompts.found_when: A published tender result names the company as a winning bidder or records a contract awarded with award amount.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: Only some result pages are indexed by search engines, or the tender was awarded under an unregistered consortium or subsidiary name.

prompts.not_found_when: No extortion entries or victim logs mention the company name; absence indicates no tracked ransomware leak.
prompts.why_it_matters: A listing on extortion trackers alerts clients and lenders that corporate data, client records, or financial files may have been exfiltrated.
prompts.question: Is the company listed as a compromised victim on public ransomware group leak blogs or threat monitoring archives?
prompts.how_to_query: Search '<business name> site:ransomlook.io' to check if any ransomware cartel (e.g. LockBit, BlackCat, Qilin) claimed a breach of the company. Tested: Astino Berhad -> https://www.ransomlook.io/. Negative test: NonExistentFakeVictimXYZ -> no match.

source.name: RansomLook (Ransomware Victim Directory & Extortion Blog Tracker)

prompts.found_when: A victim card or blog entry names the business with extortion proof, claimed data size, and publication date.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The extortion post lists a domain or trade name different from the legal registered business name.

prompts.not_found_when: No forum threads or complaint records match the business name; absence indicates no viral community disputes.
prompts.why_it_matters: Consumer dispute discussions and unresolved trade grievances expose poor fulfillment, non-payment, or deceptive practices before signing.
prompts.question: Does the company appear in consumer dispute threads or scam alert complaints on Lowyat.NET forums?
prompts.how_to_query: Search '<business name> site:forum.lowyat.net' and inspect community discussions for unresolved buyer complaints, service disputes, or warning threads. Tested: All IT Hypermarket -> https://forum.lowyat.net/. Negative test: NonExistentFakeMerchantXYZ -> no match.
prompts.found_when: Forum threads detail verified buyer disputes, payment non-compliance, or complaints regarding poor service and unfulfilled agreements.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: Search results refer to unrelated discussions using common keywords in the company's trade name.

prompts.not_found_when: No disciplinary records or sanctions against the firm appear in published MOF decision lists; the firm remains in good standing.
prompts.why_it_matters: A company or director disciplined by MOF's JKTT is barred from government procurement and indicates severe contractual default or fraud.
prompts.question: Has the Ministry of Finance Malaysia (MOF) issued disciplinary action, suspension, or blacklisting against the company or its directors?
prompts.how_to_query: Read the published JKTT disciplinary decision PDF and search for the company name or SSM registration number in the document text. Tested: Rewanas Sdn. Bhd. -> found in document text at Bil. 3. Negative test: Gamuda Berhad -> no match.

source.name: Ministry of Finance Malaysia (Jawatankuasa Tindakan Tatatertib - JKTT)

prompts.applies_when: Registered government suppliers and contractors in Malaysia
prompts.found_when: The company name or its board of directors appears in the published JKTT decision list with cancellation of field codes, suspension, or blacklisting.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The PDF cannot be fetched or the disciplinary action was gazetted in an unindexed supplementary meeting batch.
